prompt.project_info: Create a high-fidelity warm-light fashion portrait of an approved adult woman crouching on a minimalist interior staircase.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with light hair pulled back, fair skin, blue eyes, soft makeup, small gold hoops, and a gold chain. She wears a mauve dusty-rose satin slip dress with realistic drape and transparent-strap sandals, crouching on interior steps with one arm resting on her thigh and an index finger lightly near her lips; keep the pose non-erotic and editorial.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 high-angle downward portrait, subject centered on honed travertine stairs, warm LED strips beneath each tread forming repeated leading lines, crouched silhouette and soft background wall framing the figure.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm recessed LED strips around 3200K with soft overhead fill, volumetric warmth, realistic satin highlights and matched stair shadows, intimate refined atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Sony A7R V look, 35mm f/1.4 lens, f/1.8, ISO 100, 8K detail, raw-sensor character, authentic chromatic aberration, natural skin texture, accurate anatomy and hands, subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-fidelity photorealistic 9:16 fashion portrait of an approved adult woman crouching on minimalist honed travertine interior stairs. She has light hair pulled back, fair skin, blue eyes, soft makeup, small gold hoop earrings, a thin gold chain, and natural white manicure. She wears a mauve dusty-rose satin slip dress with realistic drape and transparent-strap sandals. Her weight is balanced in a compact crouch, one arm rests on her thigh and one index finger rests lightly near her lips in a calm editorial gesture. Use warm recessed LED strips beneath each step at approximately 3200K, soft overhead ambient fill, realistic satin specular highlights, matched shadows, Sony A7R V and 35mm f/1.4 perspective at f/1.8 and ISO 100, sharp face and hands, realistic skin and fabric, subtle raw-sensor grain, and no AI smoothing.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, fetish styling, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, warped limbs, distorted face, text, logo
